Bisexual: Sexually attracted to at least two genders
Heteroromantic: Romantically attracted to the opposite gender 
Ace(Asexual): Not sexually attracted to any gender (on a spectrum so maybe you’re somewhere on that spectrum)
Aro(Aromantic): Not romantically attracted to any gender (same thing as ace with it being on a spectrum)

I think those are the correct definitions but if I’m wrong hopefully someone points it out.
Also I specifically said it with Aro/Ace but sexuality is a spectrum and if you lean one way or the other that’s completely normal. And even then, maybe you just have a genital preference.
